title: 1. Roles and navigation
caption: Who reaches each screen. Event staff (cashier and SINPE desk) do not see Card, Map, or RWA.

title: 2. Account registration
caption: The user picks Customer or Merchant. The server creates a keypair, funds it on Testnet, and stores the secret encrypted. The browser never sees the private key.

title: 3. Sign in
caption: Guests go to /login. If a session cookie already exists, they are redirected to Home.

title: 4. Home — Customer
caption: Dashboard with ROJOS / XLM / USDC balances, SINPE top-ups, activity, and QR pay.

title: 5. Home — Merchant
caption: Same wallet as the customer, plus charge via invoice QR instead of scanning to pay.

title: 6. Send by public key
caption: Custodial Testnet payment. The backend signs and may wrap a fee-bump. Default asset: ROJOS.

title: 7. Pay with QR
caption: The customer opens the camera or pastes SP1|… text. Confirms destination, amount, memo, and optional ROJOS reward.

title: 8. Charge / invoice QR
caption: The merchant does not send the payment: they generate a QR that the customer settles on Testnet.

title: 9. Add funds
caption: Home → Add sheet. Four funding rails.

title: 10. SEP-24 USDC deposit
caption: MoneyGram cash or card. Requires a USDC trustline. The interactive anchor runs through server-side SEP-10/24.

title: 11. SINPE Movil top-up (customer)
caption: Parity CRC 1,000 = 1 ROJO. Promo CRC 9,000 = 10 ROJOS. If the SMS has no account code, the deposit waits for a manual match.

title: 12. Virtual Visa
caption: Rain Cards-style sandbox. Spendable balance is the Stellar account USDC. PAN/CVV only after Reveal details (20 s).

title: 13. POS simulator
caption: Sandbox Visa charge. If funds exist they are debited on Testnet to treasury. Frozen card or insufficient funds = declined.

title: 14. Map — Customer / Admin
caption: Pins for published venues. Filter by category or ROJOS promo.

title: 15. Publish venue — Merchant
caption: Nominatim geocoding. ROJOS promos are visible to customers on the map.

title: 16. RWA — Learn
caption: Education and FAQ. Tokenization is merchant/admin only. Customers go to the marketplace.

title: 17. RWA — Tokenize asset
caption: Five-step wizard. The file lands in audit for the structuring panel.

title: 18. RWA — Marketplace
caption: Buy with wallet USDC. Enforces minimum, remaining capacity, and the asset token trustline.

title: 19. RWA — Portfolio and dividends
caption: Invested capital, estimated yield, and claiming pending dividends.

title: 20. RWA — Structuring panel
caption: Admin only. Audit → legal → approve (marketplace) or reject.

title: 21. Super admin / Distributor
caption: Admin home: finance, merchants, customers, RWA, and SINPE. Event staff do not use this panel.

title: 22. Event cash desk
caption: Cashier role. Takes colones, finds the account, and credits ROJOS at the same SINPE parity.

title: 23. SINPE desk
caption: sinpe_ops role. Same assignment tool as admin, without the rest of the panel.

title: 24. Profile and sign out
caption: Account details, SINPE code when applicable, public key, and logout.
